title: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra Launch Post Discovery
summary: A cached OpenAI index page for GPT-6 Astra was discovered, revealing rollout details starting with limited organizations, followed by ChatGPT Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise, and API availability on OpenAI API and AWS. Pricing announced at $10/M input tokens and $50/M output tokens. Key benchmarks restored include ARC-AGI-3 at 98.6% and ExploitBench at 100%.
